---
title: "Lecture Notes / PPTs / Study Material"
---

```{r}
#| label: lecture-notes-material
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# Locate the QMD directory
chapter_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))

# Load GCET helper functions
source(file.path(chapter_dir, "_data_helpers.R"))

# Lecture notes folder alongside the QMD
root <- file.path(chapter_dir, "23_lecture_notes")

if (!dir.exists(root)) {

  cat("*Lecture notes folder not found.*\n\n")

} else {

  files <- sort(list.files(
    root,
    pattern = "\\.pdf$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  ))

  if (length(files) == 0) {

    cat("*No PDF lecture notes found.*\n\n")

  } else {

    for (file in files) {

      title <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))

      cat("## ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")

      path <- normalizePath(
        file,
        winslash = "/",
        mustWork = TRUE
      )

      if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

            cat(
            "```{=latex}\n",
            "\\includepdf[",
            "pages=-,",
            "pagecommand={\\thispagestyle{empty}},",
            "fitpaper=false",
            "]{",
            path,
            "}\n",
            "```\n\n",
            sep = ""
            )

      } else {

        cat(
          "[", title, "](<", path, ">)\n\n",
          sep = ""
        )
      }
    }
  }
}
```
